svg.title: படம் 2-10: Prompt Cache: கோரிக்கைகளுக்கு இடையே முன்னொட்டு KV Cache மறுபயன்பாடு
svg.desc: Three requests compare how Prompt Cache reuses the prefix KV Cache across requests: Request 1 establishes the cache; Request 2 hits it because the prefix is unchanged; Request 3 puts a dynamic timestamp at the start of the system prompt, so every token after the change point is recomputed and billed again.
